item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is doing a science project at home. She directs several parallel rays of sunlight towards three transparent objects one by one: a thin flat glass plate, a convex lens, and a concave lens.
She observes what happens to the rays after they pass through each object.
Which row correctly describes what happens to the parallel rays?

options.A: thin glass plate: converge convex lens: converge concave lens: diverge
options.B: thin glass plate: pass through unchanged convex lens: converge concave lens: diverge
options.C: thin glass plate: diverge convex lens: converge concave lens: pass through unchanged
options.D: thin glass plate: pass through unchanged convex lens: diverge concave lens: converge
